Container.Name: Nexus-Vision-AI-CPU
Container.Overview: Nexus Vision AI for UniFi Protect. CPU mode is intended for onboarding, image health, Protect-event analytics, reporting, and small evaluation workloads. Open the WebUI after first start to discover and select local Protect camera feeds.
Container.Requires: x86-64/AMD64 Unraid server, Docker enabled, 16 GB RAM recommended, and network access from this container to the local UniFi console/NVR. ARM64 and Jetson are not supported by this image.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Protected site configuration, runtime credentials, and trusted controller certificates.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: SQLite state, alert outbox, and analytics indexes.

Config.Name: Model cache
Config.Description: Persistent Torch, Ultralytics, OpenCLIP, and OCR model cache.

Config.Name: Evidence
Config.Description: Snapshots, clips, and permitted evidence exports.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Local setup and operational API port. Do not expose directly to the Internet.

Config.Name: Administrator token
Config.Description: Create a long random token used to authorize setup and read-only operational routes.

Config.Name: Door-control token
Config.Description: Optional separate bearer token for UniFi Access control. Keep different from the administrator token.

Config.Name: Site timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used by the container; the wizard stores the analytics site timezone separately.

Config.Name: Compute device
Config.Description: CPU template; keep this value as cpu.

Config.Name: License state
Config.Description: Persistent appliance identity, signed entitlement, and rollback-state directory.

Config.Name: Entitlement trust store
Config.Description: Persistent public-only Ed25519 entitlement verification key set. Never place a private signing key here.

Config.Name: Setup restart
Config.Description: Allow the authenticated local wizard to restart this restart-policy container after saving.
